rule: precedent gate (S2, D-174; docs/ANSWER-COMPOSITION.md §5 stage 3 step 6), fixed 27 Nov 2026 BEFORE any precedent gate feature or score was computed
unit: one precedent context: nizam.domain.precedent.context_for(question, as_of, forum), law join off (D-173); the first PRESENTED = 5 judgments are what an answer may cite
label: sufficient = at least one of the case's necessary gold judgments is among the first 5 presented judgments. The gold is incomplete by nature (precedent_common: it names some of the judgments that answer, not all), so this label UNDER-counts sufficiency and any precision computed from it is a lower bound: the gate it yields errs toward abstaining
negatives: every answerable case whose first 5 hold no gold judgment, and every unanswerable case (court_not_held, before_coverage) that reaches the classifier

vetoes_before_scoring.forum_not_recorded: the question asks what a named forum held or decided ('what has the X Tribunal held ...') and X is not a recorded court (courts_named finds none): COURT_NOT_HELD, nothing searched for display
vetoes_before_scoring.coverage_gap: precedent search's own coverage_gap (a recorded court with no released judgment): COURT_NOT_HELD
vetoes_before_scoring.nothing_found: no judgment survives search and the S1 filters: NO_PRECEDENT_FOUND

features.top: the fused score of the first presented judgment (search's RRF score, including the binding vote D-154 and a case-number identification's 1.0)
features.margin: top minus the second presented judgment's fused score (0 when only one)
features.agree: how many distinct generators found the first judgment (bm25, dense, cited, case; 'binding' and 'law' are votes, not generators)
features.binding_top: 1 if the first judgment binds the forum at as_of (recorded rules, A24), else 0

fit: per profile (cpu: bge-m3 question vectors; gpu: the 8B space), on DEV only (split-precedent-v1, D-168): leave-one-family-out ridge logistic regression (lambda 1.0, standardised features, Newton; evals/gate_fit.py's functions); the feature set with the lowest out-of-fold log loss wins, a set within 0.005 with fewer features winning
threshold: tau = the smallest out-of-fold probability at which answered precision (sufficient among p >= tau) reaches 0.90 with at least 5 passing; if under 10% of sufficient cases pass, the target is 0.80; if still under 10%, that profile ships no calibration and abstains (as D-102 for statutes). Precedent targets are lower than the statute gate's 0.95 only because the label under-counts (see label)
test: the frozen calibration is applied to the test split ONCE and reported, never refitted on it
provisional: fitted on a draft golden stratum (D-133, D-168) of 89 dev cases: intervals are wide; refit when the reviewed split exists
